source.title: Fantasy Football Busts 2026: Omarion Hampton, Cam Skattebo among Rotoworld's top fades
source.author: Rotoworld Staff
source.summary: Price-sensitive staff fades based on injuries, role competition, scheme fit, and inflated ADP.

takeaways.label: bust
takeaways.summary: Pierce's surgically treated ankle and likely one-dimensional role make his current price difficult to justify.
takeaways.rationale: Pierce's surgically treated ankle and likely one-dimensional role make his current price difficult to justify.
risks: A healthy return could restore his established deep role.

takeaways.label: bust
takeaways.summary: Hampton's poor zone-running results create scheme-fit risk under Mike McDaniel, while Keaton Mitchell can take enough work to hurt the price.
takeaways.rationale: Hampton's poor zone-running results create scheme-fit risk under Mike McDaniel, while Keaton Mitchell can take enough work to hurt the price.
risks: A large lead role behind a good line can overcome the efficiency concern.

takeaways.label: bust
takeaways.summary: Skattebo's inefficiency, contact-heavy style, and return from a major leg injury make his mid-RB2 price fragile.
takeaways.rationale: Skattebo's inefficiency, contact-heavy style, and return from a major leg injury make his mid-RB2 price fragile.
risks: The rebuilt run game and prior high-volume production preserve upside.

takeaways.label: bust
takeaways.summary: McLaurin now faces legitimate target competition from Stefon Diggs in a scramble-heavy offense and has rarely produced above low-end WR2 levels.
takeaways.rationale: McLaurin now faces legitimate target competition from Stefon Diggs in a scramble-heavy offense and has rarely produced above low-end WR2 levels.

takeaways.label: bust
takeaways.summary: Tuten faces third-down and power-role competition in a backfield that can become an unsatisfying committee.
takeaways.rationale: Tuten faces third-down and power-role competition in a backfield that can become an unsatisfying committee.
risks: His athleticism still gives him the highest individual ceiling in the group.

takeaways.label: bust
takeaways.summary: Burden's physical playing style, current groin injury, and crowded young offense threaten both availability and target share.
takeaways.rationale: Burden's physical playing style, current groin injury, and crowded young offense threaten both availability and target share.
risks: His talent can still win a large role when healthy.

takeaways.label: bust
takeaways.summary: Walker is priced at a career high despite Kansas City's pass preference, committee history, and his limited receiving production.
takeaways.rationale: Walker is priced at a career high despite Kansas City's pass preference, committee history, and his limited receiving production.
risks: The contract and improved team context can still produce a larger role.

takeaways.label: bust
takeaways.summary: Moore's declining route efficiency, weak separation indicators, and low target rate make an immediate Buffalo rebound a risky assumption.
takeaways.rationale: Moore's declining route efficiency, weak separation indicators, and low target rate make an immediate Buffalo rebound a risky assumption.
risks: Josh Allen and an open depth chart provide a strong environment.

takeaways.label: bust
takeaways.summary: Washington's WR30 price leaves little room for Travis Hunter, Brian Thomas Jr., and Jakobi Meyers to claim healthy target shares.
takeaways.rationale: Washington's WR30 price leaves little room for Travis Hunter, Brian Thomas Jr., and Jakobi Meyers to claim healthy target shares.
risks: Washington's late-2025 production supports a genuine lead-receiver case.

takeaways.label: bust
takeaways.summary: LaPorta's crowded offense and multi-year injury history create more downside than his premium tight-end cost reflects.
takeaways.rationale: LaPorta's crowded offense and multi-year injury history create more downside than his premium tight-end cost reflects.
risks: He remains a proven, talented scorer in an elite offense.
